what: With EVAL_CAPTURE_L1=1 (the eval_test_runner default), capture_for_item raises L1ProfilingError on peak_total=0. Any passing refusal test whose op raises ValueError on the host before allocating (DRAM input) is therefore forced to fail, and verify_supported shows it as supported_fail category other on a correct op.
suggest: Accept a zero peak (skip recording) when the graded call dispatched no program, e.g. a refusal or validate-raise; or have golden refusal helpers opt out of L1 capture.
